# Security policy

Please do not open a public issue for vulnerabilities, exposed credentials, personal Instagram exports, or bypasses of the laboratory safeguards. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for this repository.

Include the affected version, impact, minimal reproduction using synthetic data, and a proposed mitigation if available. Do not test against accounts you do not own or lack explicit authorization to assess.

The project does not accept features that enable credential attacks, control evasion, harassment, or mass collection of third-party personal data.
